title: We are busy planting trees!
description:
We're busy planting trees!🌳Today, students from Oak Park Elementary joined the Mayor, City employees and volunteers to plant 30 new trees at Oak Park Neighborhood Park.

The event is held every year around Nov. 8, Kate Sessions’ birthday, to honor the pioneering horticulturist known as the 'Mother of Balboa Park' for transforming San Diego with trees and gardens

Together, we're growing a green San Diego, one tree at a time. 💚 Happy Birthday, Kate. This is for you.

 #KateSessionsDay #SanDiegoAtWork #trees
